annotations.title: Max pain and corridor track record per expiry

description: How often BTC/ETH Deribit options settled at max pain, inside the market-maker breakeven corridor, and whether OI walls held, over hundreds of expiries — plus the most recent settled expiries (Deribit and Bybit max pain side by side) and the current max pain of upcoming expiries. Use for "will price pin to max pain on Friday?" type questions: it answers with the historical hit rate, not a prediction.
name: expiry_record

as_of.description: UTC time the underlying data was computed.

stale.description: True when the data is older than its normal refresh cycle.
